brief: 40-student classroom in Chennai school, 7x9 metres. Student desks in 5 rows of 8. Teacher desk at front with whiteboard covering full front wall. Ceiling-mounted projector. 6 ceiling fans, 2 wall-mounted split ACs. 5 windows along east wall for cross-ventilation, 1 door near front-left. 3m ceiling. Vitrified tile floor, plywood furniture.
